title: Solve Ax = b Three Ways (+ Least Squares)
hints: `A.llt()` returns an `Eigen::LLT<MatrixXd>`. Check `.info() == Eigen::Success` before trusting `.solve(b)`.
Least squares: QR works directly on the tall matrix. Don't form AᵀA: it squares the condition number and the ill-conditioned hidden test will catch it.
SVD's solve already returns the minimum-norm solution for rank-deficient A (singular values below the threshold are treated as zero).
